description: This header file declares functions related to managing the harvesting status for Neighbor Access Point (AP) on-demand scans in a network monitoring system. It includes function prototypes for setting and getting the harvesting status, along with necessary includes and licensing information.

methods.name: SetNAPOnDemandHarvestingStatus
methods.description: Sets the harvesting status for Neighbor AP on-demand scans. Returns 0 on success, 1 on failure.

methods.name: GetNAPOnDemandHarvestingStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the current harvesting status for Neighbor AP on-demand scans, returning true if enabled, false otherwise.
